# Ollama

> > Ollama is an open-source platform for running large language models locally, supporting models like llama3.2, DeepSeek-R1, Qwen3, and Gemma 3 across macOS, Linux, and Windows.

Ollama provides a unified interface for downloading, running, and managing LLMs on local hardware with GPU acceleration support. The platform offers comprehensive API references, client libraries for Python and JavaScript/TypeScript, and extensive documentation for server setup and configuration.

## Key Topics

- Ollama platform
- Local LLM deployment
- llama3.2
- DeepSeek-R1
- Qwen3
- Gemma 3
- GPU compatibility (NVIDIA, AMD)
- Python client library
- JavaScript/TypeScript SDK
- API reference
- Model library
- Context window management
- Environment variables
- Server configuration
- Cross-platform support (macOS, Linux, Windows)

## Documentation & Getting Started

- [Ollama's documentation](https://docs.ollama.com/): Main documentation hub for Ollama with quickstart and API references

## Platform Installation

- [Windows](https://docs.ollama.com/windows): Windows installation guide with NVIDIA and AMD GPU support details

## Model Library

- [glm-4.7-flash](https://ollama.com/library/glm-4.7-flash): GLM-4.7-Flash model page: 30B class MoE for lightweight deployment

## Support & Troubleshooting

- [FAQ](https://docs.ollama.com/faq): FAQ covering Ollama setup, GPU compatibility, and troubleshooting
